title: Clean Hands
summary: Silas's man has been going through your things. He's somewhere near, in the Gilded Hand's colours. Catch him. What you do with him is up to you, and Silas is watching.

goals.say: Whatever you chose, Silas will hear of it by morning.

threats.name: The Hand's Sneak-Thief
talk: Blood. A trophy. A diary. Anything that says you're like the rest of us.
Nothing. That's what scares him. That's what scares me.
Spare me and I'll tell him you're exactly what you look like. He won't believe it, but I'll tell him.
threats.target: Silas's sneak-thief is somewhere near your home.

spare.label: Let him go back to Silas
spare.line: He backs away, bowing. 'Clean. Even now. He'll hate that.'
